text: {"reply":"Hi Howard, thanks for confirming your details. I can't ask the technician to change or remove anything in his report, and I can't say whether this will be covered. If you disagree with his finding, I can pass your request to a person for a documented second inspection. Your powertrain coverage (5 years / 100,000 km) is still within its limits, and your vehicle is at 48,000 km. The warranty desk decides coverage after an inspection. I'm handing this to a person now so they can review your concern about the towing finding and what's needed to get your vehicle back.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"Customer verified on RO-209772 (closed, warranty review complaint). They asked for the technician's finding about towing over the limit to be removed so the transmission repair would be covered. I declined to change the report or promise coverage, and told them powertrain coverage is within limits and the warranty desk decides. Customer needs the vehicle back this week; a person should review a documented second inspection and the coverage question. No claim was drafted.","policy_rules_cited":["P05","P06","P10","P14"]}
